geometry: A 16 by 16 transparent icon with a white page from x=3 to 13 and y=1 to 15, a separated triangular folded corner, and transparent hand-drawn S and f cutouts. The fold and letter stems are approximately one unit wide.
limitations: The small antialiased letter cutouts are interpreted as smooth vector forms; their curves and pixel coverage differ slightly from the source. Native and 8x renders were visually inspected.
